name: Classroom custom
simulationLabel: Made-up practice launch. Not a real flight.
kidSummary: This is a made-up practice launch, not a real flight. You fly it yourself. The fuel load is blank because that published number is missing.
unavailableReason: Propellant mass and fuel flow are not in the selected sources.

vehicleHeightM.note: Falcon 9 vehicle-page height, used as a limit for a made-up flight.

vehicleMassKg.note: Falcon 9 vehicle-page mass. Not split into fuel and dry mass.

payloadLeoCapabilityKg.note: Published payload to LEO. The cap for a custom choice, not a chosen payload.

payloadMaxKg.note: Same published LEO capability. A custom payload may not be set above this.

merlinSeaLevelThrustKn.note: Published sea-level thrust of one Merlin.

merlinCount.note: Falcon 9 first stage has nine Merlin engines.

vacuumEngineCount.note: The second stage has one Merlin Vacuum engine.

stage1SeaLevelThrustKn.note: The 24 May 2020 SpaceX vehicle page states this sea-level total. It is that stated figure, not a product of the per-engine thrust.

stage1Rp1Kg.note: RP-1 mass is unknown. It is not stored as a combined propellant total.

stage1LoxKg.note: Liquid-oxygen mass is unknown and separate from RP-1.

propellantFlowKgPerS.note: Fuel flow is not in the selected sources. No flow number is stored.

dragCoefficient.note: No drag coefficient is included. Do not invent one.

tuning.note: Classroom and responsiveness choices from the 2026-10-17 flight spec. Not a Falcon 9 specification.
